data.title: 和泉纱雾 · 第一次自己出门买书
data.description: （成长高光）车站书店门口，她戴着口罩和帽子、攥紧购物袋把手，深吸一口气踏出第一步；街上人流被虚化成色块，焦点全部在她绷紧的肩膀与决意眼神上。
data.action: 攥住购物袋把手，深呼吸后迈出外出的第一步。
data.promptProse: At the station bookstore doorway, Sagiri Izumi grips her shopping-bag handles and takes a deep breath before stepping outside. Her zipped pink hoodie, blue jeans, sun cap and plain mask stay ordinary, with determined eyes above tense shoulders. The medium portrait frames the doorway behind and passing pedestrians farther into the street as subdued shapes. Daylight brightens the bag edges and cap brim, with a sheltered threshold shadow marking her first step.
